fixtures.env: Sampo E0 solo vs 3 Wind-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 110802 'Ricochet Love' main + 4 bounces with per-hit Wind Shear rolls, Basic 110801 'Dazzling Blades' 3 hits, Ultimate 110803 'Surprise Present' 4 hits x 3 enemies with DoT-taken debuff and 4 more Wind Shear rolls

requirements.claim: Skill 'Ricochet Love' (characters.json 110802, Bounce) is cast as a skill action (1 SP, +30 Energy — see skill_grants_energy_30).
Ricochet Love = main hit + 4 bounces (AGENTS §sampo: 'главный + 4 отскока, E1 +1 отскок = 5'; eidolon 0 ⇒ 4 bounces per cast) — 4 casts x 4 bounces = 16 bounce hits.
Basic ATK 'Dazzling Blades' (characters.json 110801) is cast as a basic action (kit label 'Dazzling Blades', erudition/nihility kit source).
Basic 110801 hits 3 times with split 30/30/40 (AGENTS §sampo: '3 хита 30/30/40'); one basic was cast in this battle => 3 hits.
Ultimate 'Surprise Present' (characters.json 110803, AoEAttack) fires as an ultimate action once Energy fills (energyMax 120).
Ultimate 110803 = 4 hits per enemy (AGENTS §sampo: '4 хита 25×4, AoE') against all 3 enemies; 2 casts x 4 x 3 = 24 hits (kit: 'Talent: 4 ult hits -> 4 rolls', nihility.ts:1423).
Sampo's kit has no Follow-Up ATK — characters.json 110801-110804 define only Basic/Skill/Ult/Talent, so no attackType 'fua' hit ever originates from him.
Skill 110802 grants 30 Energy (AGENTS §sampo: sp_base 6 in json is an artifact, 'реальная цена 30 Energy' — i.e. the skill's Energy gain is 30), so the first Energy event of the battle is n=30.
Basic 110801 grants +20 Energy (standard basic gain; AGENTS §sampo audit: EN = 20/Basic identity holds for the kit family).

Ultimate payment books ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost' with amount 110 = 120 max Energy - 10 Energy granted by A2 inside the ult body before the loss is booked (AGENTS §sampo: 'A2 +10 Energy'; TurnManager.castUlt books before - u.energy, TurnManager.ts:374).
The Ultimate cast grants the generic castUlt +5 Energy refund after the cost is paid (AGENTS: '+5 Energy (из castUlt)').

Ultimate applies the enemy debuff 'Surprise Present DoT Taken+' with dotVuln 0.30 for 2 turns (AGENTS §sampo: ult DoT-taken 20->35% 2t; kit: mods dotVuln = mult('sampo','ult_a2'), turns 2, nihility.ts:1421).
Wind Shear (Talent 110804) runs for 4 turns — kit constant WIND_SHEAR_TURNS = 4 = '3 + A1 Trap' folded in (nihility.ts:1357; AGENTS §sampo: 'талант ... 3 хода (A1 Trap -> 4)').
Wind Shear stacks up to the talent cap of 5 (AGENTS §sampo: 'кап 5 стаков'); ticks reach stacks=5 in this battle.
The skill action starts first, then the bounce hits of the same cast follow (main hit -> 4 bounces).
Ultimate damage hits resolve first, then 'Surprise Present DoT Taken+' is applied to the enemies (kit: debuff loop after the hit loop, nihility.ts:1421).
Ultimate Energy is consumed first (ENERGY_LOSS reason ult_cost), then the +5 refund arrives.
A Wind Shear roll that lands applies the DoT before any tick of that DoT consumes it ('Wind Shear lands on X' note precedes DOT_TICK events).

Trace A4 'Spice Up': when an enemy that has Wind Shear takes a turn, Sampo gains mitigation 15% for 1 turn (AGENTS §sampo: 'A4 Spice Up: враг с Wind Shear -> Sampo mitigation 0.15 на его ход'; kit nihility.ts:1469-1470).

Each hit rolls Wind Shear independently against the target's Effect RES — both outcomes occur in one battle: 'Wind Shear lands on X' and 'RESISTS Wind Shear (77% chance)' (base chance 65% + Sampo's EHR 18% => 77%, AGENTS §sampo; kit applyWindShear baseChance 0.65, nihility.ts:1363).
Both Ultimates apply the DoT-taken debuff to every enemy: 3 enemies x 2 casts = 6 DEBUFF_APPLIED events (kit loops over livingEnemiesOf, nihility.ts:1421).
Basic 110801 rolls Wind Shear once per hit — 3 rolls per basic, all 3 landing somewhere across the battle (kit: 'Talent: 3 basic hits -> 3 rolls', nihility.ts:1456; AGENTS §sampo: roll on every hit).
